meta.name: seo-content-writer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "write SEO content"; drafts new posts, articles, and landing pages with keywords, headers, snippets, and evidence boundaries. Not for AI-citation/GEO readiness scoring — use geo-content-optimizer; not for updating decaying existing content — use content-refresher. SEO文章写作/内容优化

copy.tagline: 撰写带关键词和标题的SEO文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为网站或博客撰写SEO友好的文章
copy.tagline_en: Write SEO articles with keywords and headers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write SEO-friendly articles for your website or blog

howto.what: 当用户要求写SEO内容时，Claude会生成带关键词、标题、摘要和证据标注的文章、博客或落地页草稿。
howto.when: 用户明确要求“写SEO内容”或“为某个关键词创作内容”时触发。

say.text: 写一篇关于“远程办公效率”的SEO文章，目标关键词是“远程办公工具”。
这是我的内容简报：……请按此写SEO优化内容。

howto.what_en: When asked to write SEO content, Claude drafts posts, articles, or landing pages with keywords, headers, snippets, and evidence boundaries.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks to "write SEO content" or "create content targeting a specific keyword."

say_en.text: Write an SEO article about remote work productivity targeting the keyword "remote work tools."
say_en.note: Claude will generate a draft following SEO steps.

say_en.text: Here's my content brief: ... Write SEO-optimized content following this outline.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the brief structure.
